Laura / Monica —

I reviewed the redline and the proposed permission scope. Legal is comfortable with logo/name use under the following conditions:

1) Usage scope limited to the specified case study assets (web page and PDF) and Redwood marketing channels (website, sales collateral, social). Any third-party redistribution (e.g., partner co-marketing) requires separate approval.
2) Usage window: 12 months from the signed permission date; we can request a renewal after that period.

5) Data/privacy: do not include any customer-identifiable PII. Aggregated metrics and percentages are fine.

Suggested legal language (please copy into the DocuSign form):
"Finexa grants Redwood Inference a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the Finexa name and logos solely as set forth in the attached Customer Marketing Permission Form for a period of twelve (12) months from the date of signature. All quotes and metrics are subject to Finexa’s prior approval prior to publication."

We’ll require a signed permission PDF before publishing. Monica — please confirm you’ve redacted any raw internal cost numbers from the draft. Laura — if you want, I can prepare the DocuSign envelope using our template; link below.
